playbook.intro: Run the presentation step by step.

1.desc: Click "Seed 30 days of data" — the seeder generates ~500 audit entries and ~23 oversight queue items.
1.title: Seed the historical database

2.desc: Go to the Dashboard. You will see total calls, blocks, PII, costs and the 24h chart.
2.title: Check the Dashboard — historical data

3.desc: Click "Run ▶" next to the "Insurance enquiry" scenario (Agent 1).
3.title: Run a scenario — positive

4.desc: Click "Customer provides PESEL and account number". Presidio masks the data before it is sent to the model.
4.title: Run a scenario with PII

5.desc: Attempted financial mutation → G-001. Prompt injection attack → G-002. Visible in the Audit log.
5.title: Trigger the G-001 and G-002 blocks

6.desc: Agent 2 requires oversight — the call goes to the queue. Go to Oversight and approve it.
6.title: Oversight queue (Art. 14)

7.desc: Select the DeepSeek agent and write any message. GovAI intercepts the traffic, scans for PII and checks policies — exactly as for Claude.
7.title: Test DeepSeek through GovAI
